description: Emoji autocomplete, generated from web (apps/web/src/chat/emoji-autocomplete.ts, mapped through the visible text as ComposerSuggestions.tsx does). `tokens`: with the caret at source UTF-16 offset `caret` in `text`, the `:` token to replace, as a source UTF-16 range `start`..`end` and its visible `query`, or null when none is open. `suggestions`: the ids web offers for `query`, in order, from the selectable entries of shared/emoji/catalog.json.
